answer: A graduated earning curve pays a new identity 10 percent, then 50 percent, then full pay only after verified work in three epochs. Each identity keeps its work thread of tasks and confirmations, which cannot be copied. 1,000 fake identities need 3,000 histories at 4 credits each, 12,000 credits while a yarrow grower spends 12 credits on one thread and reaches full pay. The k-th fake identity still costs 12 credits, so cost rises linearly with k. Thread rental fails when the glacier archive shows one delivery in two threads.
